row.notes: New row. Usage-priced PaaS: Free $0, Hobby $5/mo minimum usage (single developer workspace), Pro $20/mo minimum usage with unlimited workspace seats, Enterprise custom; per-user fields null. SAML/OIDC SSO comes with Enterprise or the $2,000/mo committed-spend tier on Pro. No SCIM in docs (llms.txt index, Enterprise section, workspaces, API guides) or pricing; membership is automated only by SAML JIT (new IdP users join the workspace) and Trusted Domains auto-join. Public GraphQL API (account/workspace/project tokens, OAuth) can read workspace and project members; no member add/remove mutations are documented. Audit logs exportable via the auditLogs GraphQL query (retention 48h Free/Hobby, 30d Pro, 18 months Enterprise). None by absence.
